generation.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original vertical 2:3 editorial portrait foundation for a Pinterest prompt card, 1024x1536. Create a refined photographic head-and-shoulders portrait of a fictional woman about 60 years old in strict left-facing profile, short naturally curly silver hair, warm medium olive skin with authentic fine lines and visible pores, quiet thoughtful gaze to the left. She wears an ochre wool turtleneck sweater with beautiful fine knit texture. No jewelry. Muted cool slate-blue seamless studio background, subtle gradient. Large diffused window light from front-left gently shapes her face, soft shadow, subtle warm highlights, exquisite realistic skin without retouching away age. Restrained editorial color grading, 85mm portrait lens, finely resolved hair. Her complete head silhouette and shoulders occupy the upper two-thirds of the frame, with breathing room before her nose and above the curls; bottom 30% is quiet out-of-focus sweater/shadow suitable for later typography. One subject, single coherent photograph. No words, no letters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no pearls, no face ornaments, no hands, no collage, no borders. Original identity and composition, not a recreation of any reference photograph.
